patch_description: This redesign separates permutation, packing, replication, and map construction into focused helpers. Group and GPU packing now use a bounded min-heap per layer, avoiding repeated linear scans over packs. Replica allocation retains the proven greedy maximum `weight / replica_count` policy, while deterministic exact-tie handling spreads replicas across source groups before choosing the lowest expert index. This reduces avoidable concentration in tied load distributions without weakening the primary load-minimization criterion.
